name: Trustwave Securities Limited
about: Trustwave Securities Limited provides financial advisory services in India. The company offers tax advisory on investments, risk advisory, security valuation, and arbitrage strategy and investment. It also provides legal consultancy services; and investment consultancy services comprising investment products, advice, and planning services related to arbitrage, investment in securities, and dealing in stressed assets. The company was formerly known as Sterling Guaranty & Finance Limited and changed its name to Trustwave Securities Limited in August 2024. Trustwave Securities Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
